descricao_produto: PRODUCT: a 6-piece kitchen knife set made of exactly these six pieces and nothing else: (1) a cleaver with a wide flat rectangular blade, a straight cutting edge and a squared front end; (2) a chef's knife with a broad blade that tapers to a pointed tip; (3) a carving knife of the same length with a narrower blade that tapers to a pointed tip; (4) a small paring knife with a short, narrow pointed blade. All four knives have matte black blades whose flat sides are covered edge to edge with a raised embossed diamond pattern of small pyramid-shaped bumps, a thin bright silver line along the cutting edge, a short glossy black bolster where the blade meets the handle, and a rounded handle with a reddish-brown wood-grain pattern of dark swirling grain lines, slightly thicker at the rounded back end. (5) A pair of kitchen scissors with two black plastic handle loops, a round silver pivot screw, a small serrated grip notch on the inner side of the handles and two plain polished stainless steel blades, one of them with a small hooked notch near the pivot. (6) A Y-shaped vegetable peeler made of matte black plastic, with a straight handle and a short horizontal white ceramic blade held between the two arms of the Y. No brand names, no logos and no lettering on any piece. The blades always stay matte black with the raised diamond pattern clearly visible, the cleaver blade always stays a wide rectangle, the peeler blade always stays white, and the handles always keep the reddish-brown wood-grain look.
